lessons: 2026-10-17: list_ad_offers acceptance is capped. Trying to place three fresh offer IDs via save_post failed with 'can not accept any more opportunities' because the publication already had 5 accepted-but-unplaced opportunities. Fix: call list_ad_opportunities(status=accepted) and embed those already-accepted opportunity UUIDs directly, rather than claiming new offers from list_ad_offers. Rank the accepted pool by payout_per_click_cents and respect send_by vs target send time the same way.
